title: Aureline M5 claim-downgrade packet
description: Canonical per-domain machine-readable claim-downgrade packet minted by the evidence-refresh scheduler and claim-downgrade lane over the frozen M5 stable-line-protection matrix. Emitted when a scheduled refresh surface — the certified-archetype report, the compatibility packet, the known-limits doc, the release / help / About surface, the public-proof surface, or the support-export packet — misses its declared freshness SLO, moving the affected claim automatically to Retest-pending (a fresh run is scheduled but not yet green), Evidence-stale (the last-success proof has aged out), or a narrower support-language claim (Limited / narrowed until refreshed). Names the downgrade scope, binds the resolved line identity, the missed-window ledger, the affected-surface reference, and the active downgrade reason so release, help, About, support, public-proof, and shiproom surfaces can prove a claim is current or explicitly downgraded rather than silently stale. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's downgrade posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
